description: Move the rollback bar and re-run evaluation (does not edit the script, records no undo step). Waits for that evaluation, so the result carries ok, errors and status (volume, bbox, bodyCount) of the rolled-back solid; status {} reads the same values afterwards without a run. An insert_* after rollback_to lands at the bar and the bar moves onto the new block, so it is evaluated. Takes return: "status" | "summary" | "full" (MCP default "status": status.script is omitted; "summary" adds status.features; "full" echoes the script).

clear.description: Remove stored anchor (bar after last feature)

id.description: Feature id the bar sits after

index.description: Gap index: 0 before all, length after last

return.description: How much of status to return: "status" drops status.script, "summary" drops it and adds status.features (the feature strip), "full" keeps the whole script. Over MCP the default is "status"; in the page it is "full". Read the script with get_script.

name: rollback_to
